title: Existence and unique infinite-order jets of straight normal weighted ambient metrics for smooth metric measure spaces with positive noninteger dimension parameter
author: Jeffrey Case; Ayush Khaitan
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 086, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.086; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The construction solves coupled tensor and density equations order by order, separating the trace-free metric correction from a two-variable trace/function system. Its determinant identifies both potential resonance orders, while the noninteger dimension hypothesis avoids them. A weighted contracted-Bianchi recurrence then forces the remaining mixed components to vanish to infinite order, completing the formal ambient construction and its jet uniqueness.

source_check.note: Select Theorem3.8 for d>=3 and finite positive noninteger m, with smooth Riemannian g, positive smooth f and real curvature parameter mu. Thus d+m is noninteger, and the claim is existence of a straight normal dilation-homogeneous Lorentzian metric/function near the metric cone whose weighted Ricci tensor and F vanish to infinite order in rho, unique modulo O(rho^infinity); it is not an exact convergent Ricci-flat PDE solution. The full local author normal-form computation, correction matrices4.3/4.5, determinant and Borel construction in4.5(i), and the remaining-component Bianchi proof of3.8 are included. Normal/straight definitions, weighted contracted Bianchi identity2.2 and density conventions are preserved. Existing unweighted straight-metric characterizations are background; the new coupled metric/function correction and weighted mixed-component argument are explicitly written. Integer warped-product specializations, resonant even/odd cases, Poincare and GJMS consequences are not separately counted.
